proposedNextAction.proposedUserFacingParagraph: If the mismatch appears only in a subscribed or imported calendar, first identify which route you used. Compare the same appointment in its original calendar and the receiving calendar, noting the date, time zone and whether it repeats. Keep the original unchanged while checking: moving the appointment to compensate for one display can create a second problem. If you consider a service that processes a calendar feed, first review whether you may share that feed and what information the service receives.
proposedNextAction.publicationGate: Editorial proposal, not integrated. Before asserting a specific Windows/IANA parsing defect or converter remedy, obtain exact current provider/format documentation or a controlled non-private test; do not generalize the publisher explanation to all one-hour errors. Any refresh menu or interval needs the actual receiving provider documentation.
